summary.text: Your payouts will come through PayNow-NRIC linked account, GIRO, or GovCash.

details.heading: Ways to receive payouts
details.body: You will receive your payouts through your PayNow-NRIC linked account, GIRO or GovCash. Linking your NRIC to PayNow can help you receive your payouts earlier.

example_phrasings: How will I receive my payouts?
How do my payouts reach me?
What are the ways I can receive my payouts?

quotes.text: You will receive your payouts through your PayNow-NRIC linked account, GIRO or GovCash.
